note: [v6:rebuild] The fish-market rebuild spec: every dimension the app builds for the C棟 roof deck (harbor/market5.js) and the north-facility quay hall (harbor/market4.js), from the photo survey (data/survey/market/features.json, docs/anime/survey/market.md). Deck positions are in the penthouse-wall frame: s = metres along the east wall from the frame origin (south-south-east, +), off = metres out from the wall face (east, +); ENU = o + s*u + off*n. Heights are T.P. metres unless named h (above the deck). Sources per block in `src`.

deck.src: deck.y (survey adjustment, eye heights + bridge pylon); the east parapet rail runs right behind the pavilions (seen through their glazing in IMG_0793 / 0798; the GSI / Earth top view's bright parapet line at off 21.3): off 23.2, 0.6 m clear of pair 3; the strip east of it is a lower roof the photos never see (they look over the rail at the bay)

rail.src: IMG_0797 / 0798 / 0793: a 0.45 m concrete upstand with a 1.1 m galvanised rail

windows.src: 24 centres measured on the wall plane (deck.window#1-24, IMG_0792 / 0795 / 0798); the triplets at s 6-14 and 109-117 by the 14.4 m triplet period (no photo sees them square-on)

wall.src: wall line, base and top: deck.wall.* (survey adjustment, GSI lot corners); windows: 1.95 x 1.64 m measured on the wall plane in IMG_0792 (six windows) and IMG_0795 (two), centres in triplets every ~14.5 m (deck.window#1-24); vents: IMG_0792 / 0795 above each triplet's middle window; letters: deck.letter.1-7 (2.4 m glyphs, IMG_0795); entrance: deck.entrance.* and IMG_0795 cuts; raised roof sections behind the parapet with rounded white end caps: IMG_0792 (s 50.8-71.0, front edge T.P. 22.9 = h 7.3), IMG_0794 / 0795 (s 99.5-117.4, h 7.1-7.6), each cut 1 m behind the wall face; the entrance landing (0.3 m step) and its two handrails cut on the deck / the rail line in IMG_0795

penthouse.src: GSI / Earth top: the upper floor fills C棟 from its west edge (off -32) to the east wall

studio.src: deck.studio.* (survey adjustment; studio face = GSI line shifted by studio_off), louvre box corners, lamp panels (IMG_0794 / 0796 / 0798); door from deck.studio.door (cut on the face plane in IMG_0794 / 0796 / 0798), its canopy flush with the face (canopy corners off 1.43 / 5.31, T.P. 18.68-19.15)

pavilions.src: 6.6 m wide, 8.3 m long (#6 6.9 m): #4 from IMG_0793 (SW corner s 73.56 / off 13.7, south face 6.6 m wide, plinth 0.79 / glass 2.1 / fascia 2.5 / raised roof end 3.6-3.8 m, cut on the measured face plane); pair 3 (#5, #6) from an edge fit of the well-registered IMG_0794 / 0796 / 0798 (best west face off 16, #5 north end s 94-95; #6 south end s 114.5 from its corner seen in all three, north end bounded by the stack S56 in the gap); IMG_0797 is not used (its pose is held only by its GPS fix: the cactus's plate cuts 7 m apart in IMG_0796 and IMG_0797, and the two photos' distances to it break the triangle inequality); pairs 1, 2, 4 centred on the GSI ortho (deck.pavilion#1-3, #7, #8, sigma 1.5 m), #8 clamped 1 m short of the studio face; outer (swept-up) ends alternate N / S within each pair (IMG_0793, 0797)

stacks.src: S67 (IMG_0796 x 0798, 3.0 / 1.6 px); S56 cut at the measured tip height on its IMG_0796 bearing (in the gap between #5 and #6, as IMG_0797 shows it); the two stacks south of #4 cut at that height on their IMG_0793 bearings (the one behind the lifeboat stands beyond it, tip T.P. 21.2); the mid-pair stacks of pairs 1, 2, 4 and the one after pair 1 by the pattern

lifeboat.src: deck.lifeboat.end_n / end_s (trailer ends on the deck, IMG_0793); the hull's stencil reads 5.30 x 2.30 x 1.00 (L x B x D); the stern faces IMG_0793 6.4 m away (its keel, sheer, canopy and hatch-box tops 0.45 / 1.07 / 1.92 / 2.23 m above the deck at that range)

col.note: column 「7」: its foot cut on the hall floor in IMG_0853 (d -7.5) and IMG_0860 (d -8.7), 8.1 m inside the face line (the roof overhangs the column line by 8 m; the outer beam band at the face is the T.P. 5.82 edge beam); a 62.2 m from the shed's south quay corner. No other column is in view over a 51.9-62.2, so the spacing is > 10.3 m: 15 m (12 bays) is assumed. The other numbers are taken to rise toward the north end (the photos show only 「7」)

hall.src: the north facility's quay hall (IMG_0853-0861, 06:53 dawn): floor T.P. 2.19 (canopy.floor_y), open from the quay face to the land-side wall (canopy.open_depth), the face edge beam's underside T.P. 5.82 (canopy.beam_bottom), a longitudinal girder over the column line (underside 6.4 where IMG_0855's dark band ends), a lighter beam band at d -4 (6.1), transverse beams over the columns

frame.note: a = metres along the quay face from its south corner, d = metres out from the face (east, + to the sea)

hall.scaleWarning: The dawn cluster's depth scale looks 2-3x short: at the solved ranges the 2 t truck's cab front (1.7 m) measures 0.8 m and the 1 t fish tubs 0.46 m wide (IMG_0855). Hall items closer than the quay face are therefore not placed from these photos (the tub rows, the conveyor); the bays they stand in are left free of the generic clutter.

carsSrc: cactus and crown: their plates cut at the plate height (0.45 m) in IMG_0796; mazda, swift and spacia at the plate spacing IMG_0797 shows (its absolute position is not trusted); centres 2.1 m behind the plate, facing west; the silver kei and the dark SUV at the row's ends (IMG_0794). Not built: the parked cars are transient (and box cars add edges that cannot match the photos); the measured positions stay here for reference
